about.eitr_linux_is_an_arch_based_linux_distri: Eitr Linux is an Arch-based Linux distribution built around Hyprland and a custom Quickshell desktop. Its own ISO and guided installer bring you to a complete keyboard-first environment, with Eitr packages delivered through a signed repository alongside Arch’s.
about.hyprland_arranges_windows_and_workspaces: Hyprland arranges windows and workspaces. Eitr’s Quickshell bar, notifications, native panels and Control Center share the same visual language. Walker and Elephant bring applications, settings and actions into one searchable menu system.
about.use_shortcuts_when_you_want_to_move_quic: Use shortcuts when you want to move quickly, or open graphical controls for sound, networking, displays and appearance. A theme reaches the bar, launcher, terminal, lockscreen and supported applications, rather than stopping at the wallpaper.
about.eitr_is_for_people_who_want_arch_s_packa: Eitr is for people who want Arch’s packages and a keyboard-first desktop without assembling every panel and everyday workflow themselves. Developer environments, cloud accounts, Git identities and coding assistants are available through its menus. Gaming, capture tools and offline dictation are part of the same desktop.
about.you_can_inspect_the_configuration_and_so: You can inspect the configuration and source, choose your tools and change the defaults. Optional assistants keep their own sign-in and permission boundaries; using Eitr does not require an AI subscription.
about.eitr_uses_arch_linux_and_pacman_with_its: Eitr uses Arch Linux and pacman, with its own desktop packages, installer, artwork and integration. On systems installed from the ISO, System Update checks for changes before creating a Btrfs snapshot and updating Arch and Eitr packages. The offline Handbook documents the desktop and recovery.
about.eitr_s_code_is_free_and_open_source_unde: Eitr’s code is free and open source under GPL-3.0-or-later. Its artwork is CC BY 4.0; third-party components retain their own licenses.
about.eitr_runs_daily_on_its_developer_s_deskt: Eitr runs daily on its developer’s desktop. Released ISOs pass automated VM checks for offline installation, updates and factory resets. That is evidence for those configurations, not a promise that every laptop, graphics card or recovery scenario has been tested.
about.the_beta_label_describes_validation_and_: The beta label describes validation and support scope; it does not remove the desktop or development workflows described here. Read the current hardware and recovery limitations before installing. Independent testing and useful problem reports help expand what Eitr can verify.

features.eitr_linux_brings_an_arch_based_system_a: Eitr Linux brings an Arch-based system, a native Hyprland desktop and everyday tools into one distribution.
features.the_custom_quickshell_desktop_includes_n: Native panels bring everyday controls together, while workspace previews help you find your windows. Search apps, settings and actions from the keyboard.
features.choose_full_centered_with_evenly_packed_: Choose a Full, Centered, Tabs, Islands, Dynamic or Drop bar layout.
features.place_monitors_beside_one_another_choose: Place monitors beside one another, choose a main display, and show the bar on one or all screens. HDR monitors get an HDR switch with SDR content brightness.
features.adjust_per_application_audio_and_microph: Adjust per-application audio and microphone controls in one panel; choose Bars or Line for the media equalizer.
features.themes_with_matching_application_colors_: themes with matching application colors, lockscreens and wallpapers.
features.add_wallpapers_from_a_file_or_link_for_a: Add wallpapers from a file or link for all themes or one theme; generate a theme from a picture, edit colors live, and create your own lockscreen.
features.keep_your_preferred_bar_position_corners: Keep your preferred bar position, corners, cursor and fonts when switching themes. Auto-hide reveals the bar at its screen edge; Reduce motion makes desktop transitions instant.
features.kitty_zsh_tmux_neovim_with_lazyvim_docke: Kitty, Zsh, tmux, Neovim with LazyVim, Docker and Lazygit are included; add editors, toolchains and data tools as needed. Plugins extend your desktop, with updates reviewed separately.
features.claude_code_codex_github_copilot_cli_gro: Install Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI and other coding assistants when you want them, or try Ratatoskr, the experimental local assistant. Your default assistant can change files and run commands without asking; you can restore permission prompts.
features.the_optional_let_assistants_work_togethe: Optional collaboration lets supported assistants request a read-only second opinion from another signed-in assistant.
features.failed_task_terminals_offer_ask_the_ai_c: Ask an assistant for help with a failed task or crash when you choose to share the details. Provider accounts and subscriptions are separate.
features.git_accounts_manages_folder_specific_ide: Keep Git identities and SSH keys separate by folder. Cloud tools keep your selected account and resource context visible.
features.system_security_users_lists_existing_hum: Create a Standard or Administrator account with a review before applying. Each new account sets up its own desktop at first login.
features.provider_menus_cover_aws_azure_google_cl: Manage cloud services through provider-specific account menus.
features.an_organization_profile_is_a_json_file_o: Organization profiles choose apps, defaults and policies for a shared setup. Review the changes before installation or apply a profile to an installed machine.
features.policies_govern_eitr_s_own_tools_they_ar: Policies govern Eitr’s tools; users with root access can override them.
features.read_the_profile_format_and_limits: Read the profile format and limits ↗
features.capture_screenshots_record_with_obs_read: Capture your screen, extract text or QR codes, and share nearby. Use local dictation or create reminders by voice and text, with calendar alerts and snooze.
features.tools_calendars_adds_read_only_google_ou: Read subscribed calendars in the desktop panel; edit events at their source. The Handbook is available offline.
features.web_apps_open_in_their_own_window_with_a: Open web apps in their own window with a chosen browser profile.
features.steam_comes_installed_with_gamemode_mang: Steam and gaming tools are included, with optional classic and cloud gaming. HDR games can enable HDR automatically on HDR monitors; compatibility depends on the game, hardware and service.
features.system_update_checks_arch_news_and_avail: On systems installed from the ISO, System Update checks Arch news and available changes, takes a Btrfs snapshot before an upgrade, and updates Arch and Eitr packages.
features.system_maintenance_check_this_pc_runs_re: Check This PC runs read-only health checks and suggests fixes for you to review.
features.system_maintenance_choose_fastest_mirror: Rank package mirrors by download speed, keeping your existing list if ranking fails.
features.recovery_includes_system_snapshots_a_boo: System snapshots, a boot guard and factory-reset procedures offer ways back. Keep independent backups and read the recovery Handbook before you need it.
features.moonlight_sunshine_sharing_and_tailscale: Set up remote play, desktop sharing or away access when you need them. Remote access remains experimental and requires a signed-in, awake desktop; stop sharing before locking for privacy.
features.read_the_setup_and_security_boundaries: Read the setup and security boundaries ↗
features.islands_groups: Islands groups controls in floating pills, with the clock centered.
features.focus_preset: Focus gives you window tabs and up to four panes per monitor, keeping your normal bar settings for later.
features.lockscreen_accounts: Choose from nine lockscreen designs. Eitr’s own carves a rune for each key you type.
features.keybinds_window_rules: Change any keyboard shortcut in Settings > Keybinds by pressing the new combination, and give apps their own window rules: always float, a workspace, a size and an opacity.
features.eitr_store: The Eitr Store installs themes, wallpapers, lockscreens and plugins, official and community, in one window, with a review before anything from the community runs.

installation.the_eitr_linux_iso_includes_the_packages: The Eitr Linux ISO includes the packages for an offline guided installation. The current download is
installation.for_early_users_with_specific_tested_con: for early users, with specific tested configurations and work still open. Beta is a validation status, not a list of missing desktop or developer features.
installation.an_x86_64_pc_or_vm_booted_in_uefi_mode_a: An x86_64 PC or VM booted in UEFI mode. Apple Silicon testing uses x86_64 emulation; it is not a native ARM port.
installation.the_guided_installer_lists_writable_disk: The guided installer lists writable disks of at least 64 GiB. Erase mode removes the selected disk’s contents after confirmation.
installation.install_alongside_mode_requires_a_gpt_di: Install-alongside mode requires a GPT disk with at least 34 GiB unallocated in one gap. Prepare that space first; the installer does not resize existing partitions.
installation.the_supported_fresh_install_layout_uses_: The supported fresh-install layout uses Btrfs for Eitr’s snapshot and recovery workflows. Disk encryption (LUKS2) asks for a passphrase of at least 12 characters and unlocks in about two seconds at boot; three or four random words are strong and easy to type.
installation.no_network_is_required_for_the_guided_in: No network is required for the guided installation. Later updates, optional downloads and online services need a connection.
installation.installation_takes_about_two_minutes_in_: Installation takes about two minutes in a virtual machine on a fast computer, with nothing to download.
installation.back_up_your_files_before_changing_a_dis: Back up your files before changing a disk. Verify the ISO with its published SHA-256 checksum and read the canonical guide for the complete installation and recovery requirements.
installation.several_machines_answers_stick_organizat: Several machines / Answers stick & organization profiles
installation.to_install_without_the_wizard_format_a_u: To install without the wizard, format a USB stick as FAT32 with the label
installation.on_it_with_the_disk_layout_encryption_us: on it with the disk, layout, encryption, user, keyboard and language. The installer validates the answers like the wizard, shows what it will do and counts down 15 seconds: Ctrl+C cancels before any disk is changed. The file holds passwords in plain text; keep the stick safe and wipe it afterwards.
installation.to_the_same_stick_with_or_without_answer: to the same stick, with or without answers, for an organization profile: removed optional apps, added software, defaults and policies, all listed in Review or the countdown before the disk changes. Every referenced file must match its SHA-256 checksum first. Policies govern Eitr’s own tools; a user with root can override them. Installs with and without a network and applying a profile afterwards have passed in a virtual machine; some checks remain open.
installation.evidence_not_a_blanket_compatibility_cla: Evidence, not a blanket compatibility claim
installation.automated_offline_installation_update_an: Automated offline installation, update and factory-reset checks.
installation.installed_from_eitr_s_iso_and_used_daily: Installed from Eitr’s ISO and used daily, with updates through [eitr]. One real configuration does not establish support for every graphics card.
installation.verified_in_a_vm_with_a_simulated_window: Verified in a VM with a simulated Windows disk. Real Windows and BitLocker configurations remain to be validated.
installation.driver_handling_exists_but_broader_real_: Driver handling exists, but broader real-hardware validation remains open. Laptop power and battery features need testing on actual laptops.
installation.encrypted_installation_and_daily_use_hav: Encrypted installation and daily use have real-machine evidence. Both factory resets and the boot guard’s rollback pass on an encrypted disk in a virtual machine.
installation.eitr_detects_graphics_hardware_and_has_d: Eitr detects graphics hardware and has driver handling for AMD, Intel and NVIDIA. NVIDIA requires a reviewed driver choice because older cards need a different driver; supported Turing-or-newer systems can use the open driver. Read the guide for hybrid graphics and non-default kernels.
installation.secure_boot_setup_is_documented_in_the_h: Secure Boot setup is documented in the Handbook and is not automatically enrolled by installation. Hardware-specific boot, encryption and recovery steps deserve their own review; a successful VM installation does not verify them on your machine.
installation.a_clean_x86_64_vm_on_linux_kvm_is_the_pr: A clean x86_64 VM on Linux/KVM is the preferred first test. A Mac testing guide is also available, with the limits of emulation explained. Move to real hardware only after reviewing the guide and keeping an independent backup.
installation.on_the_desktop_system_information_report: On the desktop, Settings → System → Information → Report a Problem prepares a report for you to inspect and send. For hardware feedback, include the Eitr version, CPU/GPU, firmware mode and the exact steps and result. Remove private information before posting a public issue.

privacy.eitr_collects_no_usage_telemetry_weather: Eitr collects no usage telemetry. Weather, updates and connected tools contact their own services. Crash notifications offer help or a report for you to review and send; they are on by default and can be turned off in the Handbook welcome.
privacy.versions_of_eitr_and_its_main_packages_g: Versions of Eitr and its main packages, graphics hardware, desktop errors and warnings, recent crashes, the installation log and recent package changes. Your user name, computer name, home folder, email, IP and MAC addresses are removed before you see it. You read the whole report before sending it.
privacy.only_if_you_send_it_by_email_to_reports_: Only if you send it: by email to reports@eitr.info, or as a public GitHub issue. An email shares your email address with us; a GitHub issue is visible to everyone.
privacy.a_report_is_used_only_to_find_and_fix_th: A report is used only to find and fix the problem it describes. It is not sold, shared or used for anything else, and it is deleted once the problem is fixed.
privacy.reply_to_your_report_email_or_write_to_c: Reply to your report email, or write to contact@eitr.info, to have your report deleted at any time. You can turn crash offers off in the welcome chapter of the Handbook. Optional cloud assistants receive messages and context you share; Control Center quick chat is read-only and keeps its conversation only in memory until closed.
privacy.the_site_sets_no_cookies_iso_download_st: The site sets no cookies. ISO download starts are counted by UTC day and filename without storing visitor data; the website displays the aggregate total. Your day/night and language preferences are saved only in this browser’s local storage. It is served by Cloudflare, which processes visitors' network addresses to deliver and protect it. The home page video loads from YouTube (privacy-enhanced mode) only when you press play.
privacy.collects_no_usage_telemetry_a_problem_re: collects no usage telemetry. A problem report leaves your computer only when you send it.

whatsnew.heading: What's new
whatsnew.get_text: Already on Eitr? Run System Update to get everything on this page. New here? Download the ISO and follow the installation guide.
whatsnew.lead: Eitr now speaks Japanese, Chinese and Korean from the installer's first screen, the bar gains Drop with its own dashboard, plugin widgets are yours to copy and turn, and the desktop follows the display you are working on.
whatsnew.languages_text: Japanese, Simplified Chinese and Korean join English, Portuguese, Spanish, German and French across the desktop, menus, Settings and the Handbook.
whatsnew.languages_point_installer: The installer now starts with Language: pick one and the rest of the setup, and the installed system, use it. English stays the default.
whatsnew.languages_point_window: The installer opens in a full-screen graphical window that can draw Japanese, Chinese and Korean, and falls back to the text console where graphics are not available.
whatsnew.languages_point_ai: Eitr's translations were made with AI and may have small mistakes. Corrections are always welcome.
whatsnew.drop_text: A sixth bar layout shows only the time in a small pill. With auto-hide it falls out of the screen edge like a drop and swells into the time.
whatsnew.drop_point_dashboard: Click the pill for a dashboard that swipes between pages: calendar and weather, quick controls, media with lyrics, performance, AI usage and notifications, each opening in place.
whatsnew.drop_point_activity: Activity gathers around the time: recording, timers, the next event, the update check, new notifications and low battery.
whatsnew.drop_point_glow: In every layout, the recording dot now glows softly while you record.
whatsnew.plugins_text: Plugin widgets have a clearer settings page and a right-click menu that groups their options.
whatsnew.plugins_point_copies: Duplicate a widget, turn it in 45° steps and choose the display each copy appears on.
whatsnew.plugins_point_icons: A new plugin's bar icons go on the bar as soon as it is installed; hide or show them per plugin. Tailscale now lives in its official plugin.
whatsnew.displays_text: With more than one monitor, Eitr shows things where you are working.
whatsnew.displays_point_notifications: Notification popups appear on every display; Settings > Notifications can keep them on the main one.
whatsnew.displays_point_obs: Record in OBS captures the display you are on, without a screen picker, and Hyprland's screen-share picker now matches your theme.
whatsnew.displays_point_wallpapers: Choose a wallpaper per display, and browse every theme's wallpapers in the carousel, with their names and a search.
whatsnew.displays_point_pickers: The emoji picker, the time picker and the wallpaper carousel open on the focused display.
whatsnew.system_text: Smaller changes that make everyday use calmer.
whatsnew.system_point_password: Password prompts use Eitr's own dialog, drawn by the bar in your theme.
whatsnew.system_point_audio: Every available audio output is offered, such as a second monitor on the same graphics card, and PipeWire runs with realtime priority.
whatsnew.system_point_usage: AI Usage shows Antigravity's limits next to Claude, Codex and Grok.
whatsnew.system_point_resize: SUPER + Ctrl + U cycles the focused window through two thirds, one third and half of the screen.
